description.narrative:
Investing in equity capital of MCRIL, a specialized advisory, ratings, policy-research and training agency, to support its regional growth and expansion plans, within home and regional markets in the DMCs.
Client/Sponsor: Micro Credit Rating Agency of India Limited (MCRIL) is the most prominent regional agency specializing in these services. MCRIL has been operating in India for nearly 14 years, and has expanded its market coverage to PRC, Indonesia, Philippines, Nepal, Azerbaijan and few other CW Asia countries, and has a credible client base (ADB, WB, IFC, DFID, USAID, PlaNet, Mix Market etc). M-CRIL is also extensively involved in social-effectiveness ratings.
